protocolMetadata.instructions: Omnilex provides tools for searching and retrieving legal sources. Use it for legislation, legislation articles, court decisions, circulars/directives where indexed, legal doctrine, commentary, citations, leading decisions, appeal chains, and source metadata. Searches can use free text plus structured filters such as jurisdiction, region, court, chamber, legal area, source type, article number, citation, language, decision date, publication date, status, and outcome where available. Return citation-friendly results with stable source identifiers, titles, summaries, dates, source URLs, and canonical Omnilex source links when available. The sandbox_* tools give you an isolated, network-less Swiss-hosted Linux workspace with LibreOffice, python-docx, the Open XML SDK and poppler for editing, converting and rendering documents.

tool.description: Start (or reuse) your isolated document sandbox. Isolated Linux VM, no network (nothing can be installed). Available: python3 with python-docx, lxml, openpyxl, python-pptx, pypdf, pillow; LibreOffice headless (`soffice`); poppler (`pdftoppm`, `pdftotext`, `pdfinfo`); qpdf. Sessions auto-suspend when idle and are deleted after the retention period; call sandbox_delete_session when you are done.

tool.name: sandbox_run
tool.title: Run code in sandbox
tool.description: Run Python (default) or bash in the sandbox, working directory /work. Python is a notebook: all calls in a conversation share ONE persistent session, so variables, imports and objects you define in one call are still there in the next (build a docx across several calls and keep using the same `doc`). A cell that raises leaves the session intact. If the sandbox was resumed after an idle gap the session restarts and in-memory variables are lost; the result then carries a notice saying so, and only then do you need to reload state from the files on disk — do not add save/reload workarounds otherwise. Returns stdout, stderr and the exit code (long output is truncated; print only what you need). Isolated Linux VM, no network (nothing can be installed). Files live under /work and persist between calls; paths are relative to it. Available: python3 with python-docx, lxml, openpyxl, python-pptx, pypdf, pillow; LibreOffice headless (`soffice`); poppler (`pdftoppm`, `pdftotext`, `pdfinfo`); qpdf.

_published_faq.name: How do I add omnilex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add omnilex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.omnilex.ai/mcp.
